name: a version 1.0 identifier stays resolvable and claims no derivation
description: Section 2.2 keeps identifiers issued under method version 1.0 resolvable and gives no assurance that they derive from a key. The example identifier of section 2.2 is one of them.
rationale: The carve-out has two halves a run can watch: the identifier still resolves, and the resolution result does not report it as issued under 1.1. Whether it happens to recompute from its key is not asked, because the text promises nothing either way.
